title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: So, as I see it - I’m drinking tequila tonight - you got 13 guys penciled into the roster. Two spots up in the air, which can go to guys on the 40-man or among these 11 ‘taxi squad’ guys: Adleman, Agrazal, Baez, Blackwood, Chiang, Faedo, Godley, Manning, Mize, Skubal, Ramirez
